description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty, which extends HTMLPurifier_Injector. It handles the removal of empty HTML elements during purification, with logic to handle whitespace and non-breaking spaces, and validates attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty
classes.description: A class responsible for removing empty HTML elements during purification, with handling for whitespace and attribute validation.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, setting up parameters for removing non-breaking spaces and predicate exclusions.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Processes an HTML token to determine if it should be removed based on emptiness, whitespace, and attribute conditions.
